name: point_cloud/default
description: Three scatter plots rendered with the PointCloud series: value-colored clusters with a color bar on the left, a marker-shape gallery top right, and a log-log power-law scatter bottom right. Judge only content inside the three plots and their panel titles; ignore the page heading, description, and control row.

checks.expectation: A wide plot on the left and two stacked plots on the right are visible, each with axes, tick labels, and a grid. Legends, the color bar, and panel titles do not overlap each other or hide the data.

The left plot shows many thousands of small, unconnected dots forming three distinct elongated or round clusters over a sparse uniform background of scattered dots. Dots are colored by a yellow-green-teal-purple colormap: cluster cores are yellow or green and outer points and background noise are blue or purple. No lines connect the dots.

The left panel title reads 'Clustered returns' followed by a point count of 250,000 (thousands separators may vary). A legend entry 'Sensor returns' shows a dot marker, not a line. A color bar labeled 'Distance from cluster core' uses the same yellow-to-purple colors as the dots.

The top-right plot shows six horizontal rows of about eight separate markers with no connecting lines. From bottom to top the rows are circles, squares, diamonds, upward-pointing triangles, downward-pointing triangles, and plus-shaped crosses, each row in a different color. The legend lists Circle, Square, Diamond, Triangle up, Triangle down, and Cross, each with a marker symbol matching its row's shape and color.

The bottom-right plot has logarithmic X and Y axes with decade tick labels. Semi-transparent orange diamond markers form a rising diagonal band from lower left to upper right with visible spread. There are no stray lines, spikes, or markers stuck at an axis edge or corner. The panel title reads 'Power-law scatter (log-log)' and reports 4000 valid of 4004.

Within the plots, axis titles, tick labels, legend text, color bar text, and panel titles are readable and free of clear raster corruption. Fail only for concrete defects such as square pixel blocks, doubled glyphs, or severe stair-step edges that make text materially illegible. Do not compare plot text with the page heading, description, controls, or any text outside the plots. Normal antialiasing, small fonts, rotated text, and backend-specific softness are acceptable.

No plot is blank, corrupted, reduced to a solid rectangle, or drawn outside its plot area. Markers render as small anti-aliased shapes, not as large squares, triangles spanning the plot, or a single solid blob.
